core_meaning.primary_meaning: Qudus is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Holy, sacred”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Qudus corresponds to the Arabic form قُدُّوس (Arabic root ق د س (q-d-s); قُدُّوس (Quddūs)). Its core sense is qudus; holy, sacred. Qudus is Arabic قُدُّوس (Quddūs) 'holy, sacred', from the root ق د س (q-d-s). The source gloss "God's Possession" is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.

persian.name: قدوس
